senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; preced.), pl. שְׁלָטִים (cmp. כֶּלִי) armor, shields; trnsf. arm-bearers; (homilet.) the righteous as the protectors of their generation.
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:4">Cant. R. to IV, 4</cite> <he>כל שִׁלְטֵי</he> … <he>שהוא עומד וישלט וכ׳</he> ‘all armors of the mighty’, this includes all those who control their inclinations &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 988:7">Yalk. ib. 988</cite>. Cant. R. l. c. <he>ולא אתם … אלא כל שלטי וכ׳</he> and not you yourselves (directly) are suspended on it (enjoy the protection of the Law), but only ‘all the shields of the mighty’ … as Moses in his time &c.
